rule: Every exception is path-, line-, category- and literal-bounded. Exceptions preserve evidence or test/control definitions; they never create aliases or excuse current assertions.

line_exceptions.label: forbidden-form definition
line_exceptions.justification: The line defines forms that the control rejects; it is not an alias or current assertion.

line_exceptions.label: outbound rejection fixture
line_exceptions.justification: The workflow deliberately submits one forbidden value and requires the validator to reject it.

line_exceptions.label: recurrence catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: The line catalogues rejected generated forms; the separate OSWELL 426 S.L. token is handled only as the unrelated entity.

line_exceptions.label: memory-error catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: The line explicitly defines transcription and template errors, not aliases.

line_exceptions.label: immutable-mail correction event
line_exceptions.justification: The line records which erroneous historical wording was corrected while preserving the sent originals.

line_exceptions.label: stale-memory correction boundary
line_exceptions.justification: The line identifies a stale memory error that must be corrected or suppressed.

line_exceptions.label: 2016 transcript spelling
line_exceptions.justification: The text expressly labels these tokens as transcript spellings/candidates and prohibits silent correction of the quoted source.

line_exceptions.label: appendix transcription literal
line_exceptions.justification: The line explicitly says the appendix transcribed the source using this erroneous form.

line_exceptions.label: transcript derivative literal
line_exceptions.justification: The line quotes and classifies the transcription candidate without normalising the source.

line_exceptions.label: evidence conclusion preserving transcription
line_exceptions.justification: The evidential conclusion expressly attributes the word to the transcription.

line_exceptions.label: forbidden-generated-alias catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: These values sit only in forbidden_generated_aliases; the actual aliases array is empty.

line_exceptions.label: public historical-error notice
line_exceptions.justification: The sentence explicitly labels the historical token as an error and denies alias status.

line_exceptions.label: aviso público de error histórico
line_exceptions.justification: La frase identifica expresamente el término histórico como error y niega que sea alias.

line_exceptions.label: redacted primary-source transcription
line_exceptions.justification: This is searchable text preserving the redacted source wording; altering it would corrupt source fidelity.

line_exceptions.label: redacted primary-source transcription
line_exceptions.justification: This is searchable text preserving the redacted source wording; altering it would corrupt source fidelity.

line_exceptions.label: machine-readable forbidden-form catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: The values are the fail-closed forbidden_generated_aliases set.

line_exceptions.label: E005 forbidden-generated-alias catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: The E005 record rejects these values and binds the legal person to company number 07716847.

line_exceptions.label: memory-governance forbidden-form catalogue
line_exceptions.justification: The values are expressly forbidden as current names or aliases.

line_exceptions.label: outbound correction event
line_exceptions.justification: The event records the erroneous wording inherited by historical sent messages and the corrective response.

line_exceptions.label: account-memory manual boundary
line_exceptions.justification: The field identifies the stale account-memory statement that must be removed or corrected.

line_exceptions.label: retrieval-only error tokens
line_exceptions.justification: The line expressly classifies both occurrences as retrieval-only errors, never aliases or current names.

line_exceptions.label: preserved source filename
line_exceptions.justification: The token occurs inside the exact historical source filename in the evidence index; changing it would break provenance.

line_exceptions.label: PWC appendix source spelling
line_exceptions.justification: The first occurrence is attributed to the appendix and the second expressly controls preservation of that source spelling.

line_exceptions.label: retrieval-error token list
line_exceptions.justification: The enclosing field classifies these values as retrieval errors that are not aliases.

line_exceptions.label: preserved source filename
line_exceptions.justification: The token occurs inside the exact historical source filename and is retained solely to preserve provenance.
